summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Wetour Robotics Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing press releases dated April 29 and May 1, 2026. The press releases announce four development milestone demonstrations of the company's Orchestra platform, including VisionLink and Conductor modules, which showcase real-time multi-modal edge AI capabilities such as gesture control, haptic feedback, and EMG-based hand tracking. There is no mention of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or capital return. The filing is a routine operational update with no corporate event requiring classification.
